declaration.preparation: d45809d8 refused scalar Up-index during declaration, before any output or lead-lag outcome; integer scalar/one-element integer array now validated explicitly, no numeric design change.
declaration.design: 72 scheduled BTC windows: first5min of every third UTC hour,9 previously consumed dates. Missing windows remain statuses; no backfill. This samples days, not all288 windows/day.
declaration.unit: Neutral100ms diagnostic grid, not order actions, fills or independent samples. No execution or PnL claim.
declaration.clocks: Primary local receipt clock; separate source-clock diagnostic sorted by venue timestamp, not a causal executable clock. No offset fitted.
declaration.prices: Published Up BBO only; preserve invalid rows; strict two-sided 0<bid<ask<100, no cross-token reconstruction.
declaration.correlation: Within-window/phase centered100ms mid changes; positive lag means PM change precedes Predict change. Both lag endpoints remain in same phase/window.

null.method: circular shifts of PM changes within each window/phase by >=10s; family maximum of absolute positive-minus-negative-lag asymmetry across7lags x4phases=28, primary receipt/1s freshness only

declaration.prediction: Expanding chronological ridge: first3 dates train, next6 test; primary1s future Predict mid change, 0.5s/5s descriptive. Baseline Predict past0.2/1/5s moves, Binance past0.3/1/5s moves and fixed current p(1-p)/sqrt(time-left) interactions, current Predict mid/spread/time/phase; add PM past0.2/1/5s moves. Standardize train only; fixed ridge penalty1. No tuning, no settlement labels. Same eligible rows for both models; zero-change forecast also scored.
declaration.inference: Descriptive sampled-window study. Report per-day stability and shifted-clock null; no confidence intervals or independent-validation claim from incomplete-day sampling.
declaration.contracts: Historical Polymarket metadata names BTC/USD TWAP. Predict registry and current docs identify its own reference round. Same UTC window is not identical strike/payoff; phases retained separately.
declaration.protections: No Nov4..6,Nov9..13 quote or outcome payloads; no live/frozen changes; single light process.

null.interpretation: Timing alignment diagnostic; no confidence interval, independent-day validation, venue-causality or trading claim.

limitations: Scheduled-window sample, not a complete-day census; no intervals or independent validation.
Different contractual settlement definitions and strikes; price gaps are not executable arbitrage.
Quote tick sizes, batching and different settlement sensitivity can create apparent timing differences.
Local receipt ordering includes network/collector latency; source timestamps are different venue clocks.
Incremental chronological model performance is exploratory; no fees, queue fills, own latency, or PnL evaluated.
